text:
ana: Starting Silverlane POC. Needs streaming chat + function/tool calling, deterministic NDJSON output (one JSON object per event), SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS (BYOK), and ephemeral browser creds. Theyd like a smooth reconnect/resume strategy and a quick pricing ballpark for spikes (~1k QPS for 15m).

mike: Browser + server? And do they require mutual-TLS for webhooks?

ana: Browser product pages (SSE) + backend workers. They asked for mutual-TLS on webhooks if we push callbacks.

riyad: TL;DR tech: JS/py SDKs support streaming + function_call events. For NDJSON we emit one JSON-per-line; use sequence numbers for gap detection. Example SSE event payload: `{"seq":123,"type":"function_call","name":"calc_route","args":{...}}`. Recommend resumable_id pattern: server returns `resumable_id` as a control event on start. On reconnect, client reopens with `?resumable_id=...&offset=seq_last_received`.

mike: Note edge: SSE + shortlived tokens can 401 midstream and cause reconnect storms. Workaround: broker tokens serverside or use resumable_id so reconnects are cheap. We have helper code in branch "sse-resume-lite".

security-bot: Hosted+BYOK + outbound mTLS requires enterprise plan + legal LOA + cert onboarding. Customer-managed at-rest encryption for payloads will likely trigger Dedicated/Private recommendation. SOC2 report available under NDA. Expect ~2 week legal/KMS lead time.

ana: Can you add telemetry? They want trace_id per event and token-level cost sample in the demo.

riyad: We emit trace_id header per request and cost estimate metadata at request end (usage tokens). Ill include a sample NDJSON line with trace_id and cost: `{"seq":124,"trace_id":"t-9a8b","type":"message","text":"...","cost_tokens":0.012}`.

mike: I'll draft a onepager runbook (SSE NDJSON snippet, websocket fallback, resumable_id + offset pattern, token broker example, sequence-number recovery, safari keepalive hints) + a tiny cost calc sheet (hosted vs reserved Dedicated).

riyad: Known blocker: Node/browser SDK auto-reconnect for resumable flows isn't fully wired; PR #2117 adds a small client helper to supply resumable_id and refresh creds gracefully. CI queued. If PR misses demo timeline, use server token broker for the browser demo.

ci-bot: PR #2117 opened by @riyad - "sse-resume-client-helper" (CI checks running).

ana: Action items: Mike -> runbook + cost sheet; Riyad -> sample NDJSON quickstart and trace/cost example; Security -> LOA template and cert onboarding checklist. Customer contact: natalie@silverlane.com. Scheduling: target Tue demo. :thumbsup:
